data.title: 姬柊雪菜 · 温泉旅馆的薄被微醺
data.description: 温泉旅馆榻榻米房间内飘散着淡淡甜酒香气。喝了点甜米酒的雪菜整个人缩在宽厚的羽绒被窝里，双颊酡红如熟透的苹果。纯白浴衣领口微散，露出修长优美的玉颈。她鼓起微烫的小脸假装生气噘嘴，眼中却闪烁着藏不住的依恋，软软地向你宣称自己一辈子都不会离开前辈。
data.location: traditional ryokan tatami room with futon spread out
data.action: tucked into fluffy futon, collar of white yukata slightly open, heavily flushed cheeks from sweet sake, pouting cutely, brown eyes glimmering with tipsy affection
data.lighting: warm ambient light from paper shoji lantern
data.mood: adorable tipsy pout, deeply touching innocence
data.promptProse: Snuggled in a warm futon in a traditional ryokan, Yukina blushes intensely from sweet sake with her yukata collar slightly relaxed. She pouts adorably with glistening brown eyes full of affection.
data.animaCaption: Yukina pouting adorably in a warm futon with flushed cheeks after sweet sake.
